characters.name: Gutten
characters.description: A young, adventurous boy with a curious nature. He is of average height with a lean build. Initially, he wears simple, tattered clothing befitting a poor background, but later dons radiant, rustic armor. His hair is disheveled, and his face portrays innocence blended with bravery. The setting often places him in mystical, fairy-tale environments, like inside a humble home, mysterious rooms, and battlefields.

characters.name: Prinsessen
characters.description: A beautiful young princess with an air of grace and kindness. She has long, flowing hair and soft, elegant features. Usually adorned in regal clothing, she exudes charm and poise. Her demeanor is gentle, and she plays a significant role as she discovers the boy's true identity. Her setting is typically within a grand palace.

characters.name: Hesten
characters.description: A majestic black horse with a strong and powerful physique. Its presence is mystically vibrant, often accompanied by a gothic ambiance when interacting with the boy. Eventually revealed to be a prince, the magical transformation highlights his noble origins and the fantastical elements of the story.

characters.name: Prinsen
characters.description: The transformed version of the horse, now appearing as the most handsome and regal prince. He has a noble and dignified demeanor, indicative of his royal heritage. His attire is princely, reflecting his majestic and magical transformation from a horse into a human.

characters.name: Mannen
characters.description: A mysterious and enigmatic figure who interacts intermittently with Gutten. He possesses a stern and commanding presence, often depicted in shadowy or mystical settings. His attire is dark and traditional, complementing his role in a tale filled with forbidden rooms and magical trials.
